curated-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic keeps its small letters wide open and its x-height tall, a sans-serif that is easy to follow (a motorcycle club could use it). Noto Sans Arabic sits under Bruno Ace, whose ruler-drawn line never swells in the bowls and lingers one character per beat.
curated-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bhutuka-expan: Wide, drawn-out, unmistakably showy. Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads, while BhuTuka Expanded One, a serif with curvy, unclamped forms, slows a long paragraph to a leisurely walk (a fishing lodge, say).
curated-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-google-sans: Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters out like beads on a long thread. It is made for display, with open apertures and no calligraphic thinning, whereas Google Sans handles the running text with terminals pulled well back and no thick-thin shift in its curves.
curated-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-solway: Expressive and a bit theatrical, Bruno Ace SC stretches its open letters wide. Solway, a serif with stencil-flat line weight and a generous entry into the e, gives that spacing a bookish, authoritative floor to stand on.
curated-gf-butterfly-kids-gf-copse: Butterfly Kids wraps its c into a closed ring of snapped wire, hand-drawn and relaxed, with a low band of small letters between long stems. And Copse lets daylight through every curve of its serif, which suits gentle reading (a maker brand story card, for one).
curated-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-noto-sans-tai: Cabin Sketch draws every stroke as stout as a pipe cleaner, curves and straights sharing one width, so it loudly carries the headline (a triathlon event poster, maybe). And Noto Sans Tai Tham, a sans-serif, crowds its lowercase toward the capital line while keeping the c clearly open.
curated-gf-caveat-brush-gf-kanchenjunga: Chunky, friendly, tightly packed. Caveat Brush closes up its c, e and s for a clamped, handmade look, and Kanchenjunga, a sans with a drafting-pen line that never clogs, handles the details (a craft fair booth sign, for instance).
curated-gf-chewy-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Chewy jams its characters close together and tucks its terminals in near the bowl, with no hairlines to squint at (a barbershop sign, say). Noto Sans Thaana, a sans with wide channels into each counter and big open lowercase forms, gives it room to breathe.
curated-gf-concert-one-gf-dosis: Dosis squeezes its tube-like, neon-glass strokes tight yet leaves a wide gap at the e's terminal, a sans-serif that is comfortable in modest amounts (a concierge service brand, perhaps). Concert One seals its letters behind slim entrances.
curated-gf-croissant-one-gf-alike-angula: Alike Angular is a text serif with a subtle thick-thin cadence and letters held open. Croissant One spreads out far wider, its curves swelling and then thinning to a thread, so it belongs up top (a calligraphy practice sheet, say).
